r.통화: Hong Kong dollar (pegged to the US dollar) · 1 HKD = 170 won
r.주식시장 시가총액: $6.1 trillion, 1425% of GDP (2025, listed domestic companies)

t.etext: A financial center with one of the world's top stock markets, banks and wealth management. It is the gateway through which Chinese companies raise money from foreign investors. Its port, re-export trade and logistics are also big. The Hong Kong dollar is pegged to the US dollar, so it follows US interest rates.
